companyContext: French leisure group operating theme parks and ski resorts across Europe (Parc Astérix, Futuroscope, Grévin, Walibi parks). Owner-operator of Walibi Rhône-Alpes since 2006.
brandContext: French theme park located in Les Avenières (Isère), between Lyon and Chambéry. Opened in 1979 as Avenir Land, it spans 35 hectares with 36 attractions and shows organised across three themed worlds: Explorer Adventure (Wild West), Festival City (New Orleans) and Exotic Island (Pacific-inspired with the flagship Mahuka single-rail coaster). In 2025 it welcomed 616,000 visitors, its second-best season.

brandVision: Become a complete and differentiating regional leisure destination — moving beyond a seasonal amusement park to a year-round family playground for adventure, thrills and shared emotions, anchored locally in Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes while attracting wider audiences with bold themed universes and signature events (WAAAlloween, Merry ChristWAAAs).
brandValues: Family fun, shared emotions, adventure and exploration, thrills made accessible, festive and playful spirit (the iconic 'WAAA'), warm hospitality, regional anchoring, immersive storytelling and sustainable operations (photovoltaic parking, local recruitment).
